note: Held-out batch B (sealed). Hand-written from the RFP text before any tool run. All values are those in force after Addendum 2. Layout: the two addenda come FIRST, newest on top, with dates as M/D/YY; the RFP as issued follows, with decimal section numbers to three levels. Addendum 1 moves the due date and the answers date, cuts the page limit and adds a form. Addendum 2 moves the due date again and changes its time, moves interviews and award, deletes requirement 4.3.6, changes the scoring and removes a form.

requirements.text: Letter of transmittal. Identify the firm, state whether it proposes for general counsel, development counsel or both, and name the person authorized to commit the firm. An authorized person must sign the letter.
Firm background. Describe the firm, its offices and number of attorneys, and its practice representing housing authorities.
Key personnel. Name the lead general counsel, the lead development counsel and the other attorneys who would do the work. Describe the qualifications of each and attach resumes.
General counsel experience. Describe the firm's experience providing the services in Section 3.1 to housing authorities or comparable agencies.

Development and finance experience. Describe the firm's experience with the services in Section 3.2. List the affordable housing transactions closed in the last six years, giving for each the number of units, the financing sources and the firm's role.
References. Provide at least three references from housing authorities or public agencies, with current contact details.

Conflicts of interest. Disclose any relationship with the organizations named in Section 1.4, with any Commissioner or employee of the Authority, and with any developer, lender or investor active in Dunmarrow County. Explain how the firm screens for conflicts in development work.
Fee schedule. Provide hourly rates for each attorney and paralegal. For development work, also propose a fixed fee per transaction for a typical tax credit closing and say what it includes.

Staffing plan and availability. Explain how the firm would cover Board meetings, urgent requests and simultaneous transaction closings, and describe the firm's plan to take over open matters from current counsel in the first sixty days.
Litigation history. Every proposal must also state whether the firm has been sued for professional negligence in the past five years and how each such claim was resolved.

extra_fields.source_line / source_line_no: on each deadline: the line of the RFP file (stripped, 1-based number) that states the date in force. For a date changed by addendum it is the addendum line; original_source_line is the line in the body.
extra_fields.section, numbered, text: on each requirement: the section it sits in, whether the RFP gives it a number or label, and its exact text with runs of white space collapsed to one space (the label itself is left out).
extra_fields.alt_labels, alt_qtypes: other labels or question types that a scorer should also accept. Question types are the test author's judgement.
extra_fields.deleted_requirements: requirements removed by addendum. They must NOT appear in the parsed requirement list.
extra_fields.evaluation_as_issued, forms_as_issued, b: values before any addendum, for checking that the change is shown.
extra_fields.addendum (on addendum_changes): which addendum made the change. Kinds beyond the existing keys: requirement_deleted, criterion_removed, weight_changed, insurance_changed, form_removed; time_from and time_to are given where an addendum changes the time of day.
extra_fields.amount_value: insurance amount as a whole number of dollars.
extra_fields.dates_that_are_not_deadlines: dates in the text that must not be read as schedule deadlines.
extra_fields.not_requirements: numbered or lettered items that are not proposal requirements (scope of services, general conditions, table of contents). Reading them as requirements is an error.
extra_fields.kind_not_in_existing_keys: marks a deadline kind the existing keys do not use; score it separately.
